description: 弃象引入，马后双将，连串将杀
explanation_en: A bishop sacrifice draws out the king for a knight-and-queen double check, followed by a forcing attack and mate.

intro.popup: 💡 双将：白方弃象引入黑王，利用马后双将发动连串攻击。此局较复杂，可多加研究。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Double check: White sacrifices a bishop to draw out the black king, then uses a knight-and-queen double check to launch a series of forcing attacks. This is a complex position worth studying.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：弃象引入→Ne8+双将（马攻g7，后揭开对角线）→连串将杀→Qf2#。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Sacrifice the bishop to draw out the king, then Ne8+ gives a double check (the knight attacks g7 as the queen's diagonal opens), followed by a forcing attack and Qf2#.

moves.popup: 白象弃子！Bg7+将军，强制黑王吃象，将黑王引至g7——为马后双将创造条件。
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the bishop with Bg7+, forcing the black king to capture it on g7 and setting up the knight-and-queen double check.

moves.popup: 黑王被迫吃象，落入陷阱。
moves.popup_en: The black king is forced to capture the bishop and falls into the trap.

moves.popup: 双将！白马跳e8攻g7，同时揭开白后e5沿对角线直指g7！黑王无法同时挡马和挡后。
moves.popup_en: Double check! The knight jumps to e8, attacking g7 and uncovering the queen on e5 along the diagonal. The king cannot escape both checks at once.
The black king moves to h6.

moves.popup: 白后Qf4+，沿对角线攻h6将军，黑方只能用兵阻挡。
moves.popup_en: Qf4+ checks the king on h6 along the diagonal. Black can only block with a pawn.

moves.popup: 黑兵g5挡将，但这为白方后续将杀制造了新漏洞。
moves.popup_en: The black pawn blocks with g5, but this creates a new weakness for White's attack.

moves.popup: 白后Qf6+，沿第6横线将军h6，黑马保护f6使黑王无法吃后。黑王被迫逃跑。
moves.popup_en: Qf6+ checks the king on h6 along the sixth rank. The knight protects f6, so the king cannot capture the queen and must move.
The black king moves to h5, still under attack.

moves.popup: 白马Ng7+将军h5，黑王只能继续逃跑。
moves.popup_en: Ng7+ checks the king on h5. The black king must keep running.
The black king moves to h4, with nowhere left to hide.

moves.popup: 白后Qf2将死！后攻h4对角线，马h3和车h1封死逃路，黑王无路可逃。精彩的连串将杀！
moves.popup_en: Qf2 is checkmate! The queen attacks h4 along the diagonal, while the knight on h3 and rook on h1 cover the escape squares. A beautiful series of forced checks.
